question: In the forward osmosis experiments, what COD and osmotic pressure did the municipal wastewater feed have?
rendered:
A Comparative Study of Forward Osmosis Systems: An Integrated Experimental, Modeling, and Techno-Economic Analysis, page 2

According to the text, the municipal wastewater (WW) feed had a chemical oxygen demand (COD) of 460 mg L−1 and an osmotic pressure of 2.5 bar.
